about: AI teacher skill files for Somo 4. The admin page (somo3/) lists these when adding an AI teacher, and saves a copy of the file's text with the teacher. To add a new AI teacher type, copy TEMPLATE.md, fill it in, and add it to this list.

skills.name: Mwalimu Neema
skills.for: Ages 5 to 6: first letters, sounds and counting

skills.name: Mwalimu Juma
skills.for: Ages 6 to 9: numbers coach (sums, tens and ones, taking away)

skills.name: Mwalimu Amani
skills.for: Ages 7 to 9: reading coach (blending, tricky words, sentences)
